preconditions.description: Attacker must have some balance of the LineAxis token to demonstrate the issue
Contract must not be frozen (frozen == false)

exploit_hint: The ERC20 approve() function incorrectly checks that the approval value is less than or equal to the caller's balance instead of checking the spender's allowance. Call approve() with a value greater than your token balance to trigger the revert, demonstrating the incorrect implementation. This violates ERC20 specification where approve() should set allowance regardless of the caller's balance.
